Name: Pemko 36" x 80" Rigid Jamb Weatherstrip Set - (Dark Bronze Anodized)
Natural: Pemko Rigid Jamb Weatherstrip for 3' x 6'8" door. This Pemko perimeter gasketing is designed to seal the gap around the top and the 2 sides of a door assembly. The side jambs are provided as two pieces. Rigid jamb weatherstrip is designed for openings with 1/16" gaps; however, each weatherstrip can seal gaps up to the depth of its seal. Punched on 6" center with slotted holes for adjustment. Can be installed on a wood or metal frame. Dark bronze anodized finish.
